claims.text: The HMMWV (M998-series) separate oil cooler is designed to cool engine oil.
The upper half of the HMMWV (M998-series) separate oil cooler typically cools engine oil as engine oil passes through the cooler.
The lower half of the HMMWV (M998-series) separate oil cooler provides additional cooling or recirculation, depending on operating conditions.
The lubrication-test chart in TM 9-2320-280-20-1 (Volume 1, 1996, including Change 2, 2004) indicates an approximate engine-oil pressure of 40 to 50 psi at 2,000 RPM.
The approximate engine-oil pressure of 40 to 50 psi at 2,000 RPM is based on standard operating conditions and typical performance for the M998-series HMMWV.
Standard maintenance practices suggest that engine oil is cooled throughout the HMMWV (M998-series) separate oil cooler, with the upper and lower sections contributing to overall cooling efficiency.
